comment: WYRM.LAB benchmark entrants. API keys are NEVER stored here — each model names an environment variable (apiKeyEnv) that must be exported before `bun scripts/run-benchmark.ts` runs. Resilience fields (contextWindow, rpm, tpm, concurrency, timeoutMs, maxRetries, retryBaseMs, costPerMtok) map 1:1 onto the provider reliability engine; 0/absent = engine default.

models.name: WYRM-BFS
models.note: Exhaustive breadth-first solver. Provably optimal play — the reference line every LLM is measured against. No API, no cost, deterministic.

models.name: GLM-4.6
models.note: Built-in sandbox model. Zero-config fallback brain of the arena.

models.name: Kimi K3 (Moonshot)
models.note: Moonshot's 3T-class open flagship, 1M-token window. OpenAI-compatible endpoint verified on platform.kimi.ai. reasoning_content streams are recorded as thinking.

models.name: MiniMax M3
models.note: MiniMax's frontier multimodal coding model, 1M-token window. OpenAI-compatible endpoint verified on platform.minimax.io.

models.name: Qwen Plus (DashScope)
models.note: Alibaba Qwen via the OpenAI-compatible DashScope endpoint (international base; CN accounts use dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1).

models.name: GLM-4.7-Flash (free)
models.note: PERMANENT FREE tier on z.ai (email-only signup, no card) and open.bigmodel.cn. OpenAI-compatible at api.z.ai/api/paas/v4. The strongest zero-cost entrant in the arena.

models.name: GLM-4.5-Flash (free)
models.note: Second free GLM Flash line — different character than 4.7-flash, same zero cost.

models.name: GPT-5.2 (PiAPI bundle)
models.note: PiAPI aggregator: GPT-5.2 at 50% of OpenAI list price, OpenAI-compatible, one key for the whole bundle (Claude/DeepSeek/Gemini too).

models.name: Claude Sonnet 4.6 (PiAPI bundle)
models.note: Claude Sonnet 4.6 via PiAPI at 75% of Anthropic list price — the bundle's reasoning specialist.

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Flash (free tier)
models.note: Google AI Studio free tier — no credit card, generous daily caps. The zero-cost entry point for frontier-family models.

models.name: Llama 3.3 70B (Groq)
models.note: Groq free tier — no credit card, LPU-class speed. The arena's favourite free horsepower.

models.name: GPT-OSS-120B (Groq free)
models.note: OpenAI's open-weight 120B on Groq's LPU free tier — frontier-adjacent, zero cost.

models.name: Nemotron 3 Ultra (NVIDIA NIM)
models.note: build.nvidia.com free evaluation endpoint: 82 open models, phone verification, no card, up to 40 rpm. Also hosts gpt-oss-120b, Kimi K3, DeepSeek V4 Flash.

models.name: Llama 3.3 70B (Cerebras)
models.note: Cerebras wafer-speed inference — paid/pay-as-you-go; the $5 trial requires a verified payment method (verified 7 Nov 2026), so it is OFF the free list. Keep if you have a card.

models.name: Mistral Small (Experiment tier)
models.note: Mistral La Plateforme Experiment tier — ~1B tokens/month free (1 req/s). Phone verification required.

models.name: Llama 3.3 70B (Cloudflare free)
models.note: Workers AI free allowance: 10,000 neurons/day. Replace REPLACE_ACCOUNT_ID in baseUrl with your Cloudflare account id. Edge catalogue also carries gpt-oss-120b and glm-4.7-flash.

models.name: Command R+ (Cohere trial)
models.note: Cohere trial key: 20 rpm, 1,000 requests/month, non-commercial. Compatibility endpoint is OpenAI-shaped.

models.name: Qwen 2.5 7B (SiliconFlow ¥0)
models.note: SiliconFlow's ¥0 open-weight tier (Qwen/GLM/DeepSeek rotate through it). Small-context stress test for the context fitter.

models.name: OpenRouter :free pool
models.note: Any :free model on OpenRouter — one key, ~25 free models. Free accounts: 20 rpm / 50 requests/day (1,000/day once you ever bought $10 credit). Swap modelId freely.

models.name: OpenRouter auto-free
models.note: OpenRouter's auto-router: names the best currently-available free model for the request — the arena's rolling dice entrant.

models.name: Qwen 2.5 14B (Ollama)
models.note: Fully local, no key. Demonstrates the small-context path: the context fitter truncates history with a visible marker.

models.name: Any Model (MCP bridge)
models.note: ANY model reachable over MCP. apiKeyEnv must export WRYM_MCP_ENV='LLM_BASE_URL=http://localhost:11434/v1;LLM_MODEL=qwen2.5:14b' (or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint). Full guide: docs/MCP_SUPPORT.md. Test the chain with `bun scripts/test-mcp.ts`.
